title: Self-organizing reinforcement learning: a learner-free swarm approaches the explore-exploit optimum
abstract: arXiv:2610.25113v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The explore/exploit trade-off is the core problem of reinforcement learning (RL). We show that a minimal foraging swarm approaches its optimum - the ideal-free / Nash allocation of a multi-agent resource-sharing game (an equilibrium, not a return maximum) - with no learner and no reward signal. Agents explore by heavy-tailed (Levy) flights, recruit neighbours to a discovery through a threshold cascade on their proximity network, and disperse as a patch crowds; this cascade cycle balances exploration and exploitation and drives foragers toward the ideal free distribution. The swarm attains the shape of this optimum (committed foragers track richness with slope 0.94) but not its exact equilibrium - it stays measurably exploitable - reaching it dynamically (~150 steps) through the coupling of recruitment to movement: remove the coupling and matching collapses (0.94 -> 0.08). translated_title: 自组织强化学习：无需学习者的群体逼近探索-利用最优解
translated_abstract: 探索/利用权衡是强化学习（RL）的核心问题。我们证明了一个极简觅食群体在无需学习者、无需奖励信号的情况下即可逼近其最优解——即多智能体资源共享博弈的理想自由/Nash分配（这是一个均衡，而非回报最大化）。智能体通过重尾（Levy）飞行进行探索，通过在其邻近网络上的阈值级联将邻居招募到新发现的资源处，并在资源斑块拥挤时分散离开；这种级联循环平衡了探索与利用，并驱使觅食者趋向理想自由分布。该群体达到了这一最优解的形态（专注觅食者以0.94的斜率追踪资源丰富度），但并未精确达到其均衡——它仍存在可测量的可利用空间——而是通过招募与运动的耦合在动态过程中（约150步）逼近该状态：一旦移除这种耦合，匹配即告崩溃（0.94降至0.08）。
tldr: 一个无需学习者与奖励信号的极简自组织觅食群体，通过Levy飞行探索、阈值级联招募与拥挤分散三者的耦合循环，能在约150步内动态逼近多智能体资源共享博弈的理想自由/Nash均衡分配（匹配斜率达0.94），且移除招募-运动耦合后匹配会崩溃至0.08。
